description: Berlin-based TTS company (Coqui Studio + API, commercial XTTS licences). Studio disappeared from coqui.ai in mid-December 2023 and by early January 2024 the homepage read 'Coqui is shutting down' (Wayback 2024-01-05). No exact end date was published. The open-source TTS/XTTS code continues as the community fork idiap/coqui-ai-TTS (PyPI coqui-tts). The XTTS weights remain on Hugging Face under the non-commercial Coqui Public Model License.
name: Coqui
